+"""Team SSO purchase, setup, sign-in and signed directory event routes."""
+
+import json
+import secrets
+import time
+from urllib.parse import urlencode
+
+import httpx
+from cryptography.fernet import InvalidToken
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
+from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+from sqlmodel import select
+
+from .. import client_ip, crypto, ratestore
+from ..application import enterprise_billing, enterprise_sso
+from ..config import get_settings
+from ..domain.identity import session as identity_session
+from ..domain.identity.access import Caller, _user_from_session, require_member
+from ..infra import workos
+from ..infra.db import session_maker
+from ..models import EnterpriseSSO, Org
+from .auth_helpers import _is_https, _same_origin
+from .billing import _return_base
+
+
+router = APIRouter()
+STATE_COOKIE = "treg_sso_state"
+
+
+def _signin_failure(reason: str, slug: str = "") -> RedirectResponse:
+    query = {"sso_error": reason}
+    if slug:
+        query["team"] = slug
+    response = RedirectResponse("/?" + urlencode(query), status_code=303)
+    response.delete_cookie(STATE_COOKIE)
+    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
+    return response
+
+
+class CheckoutIn(BaseModel):
+    plan: str
+    price_id: str
+
+
+class EnforceIn(BaseModel):
+    enabled: bool
+
+
+class DiscoverIn(BaseModel):
+    email: str
+
+
+class ITContactIn(BaseModel):
+    email: str
+
+
+def _owner(caller: Caller, org_id: int) -> None:
+    if caller.org_id != org_id or caller.role != "owner":
+        raise HTTPException(403, "team owner required")
+
+
+@router.get("/orgs/{org_id}/sso")
+async def sso_status(org_id: int, caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    if caller.org_id != org_id:
+        raise HTTPException(403, "team membership required")
+    return await enterprise_billing.status(org_id, include_plans=caller.role == "owner")
+
+
+@router.get("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/blocked")
+async def sso_blocked_members(org_id: int, caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    return {"members": await enterprise_sso.blocked_members(org_id)}
+
+
+@router.post("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/blocked/{user_id}/restore")
+async def sso_restore_member(org_id: int, user_id: int, request: Request,
+                             caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    if not _same_origin(request):
+        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-origin request rejected")
+    try:
+        await enterprise_sso.unblock_member(org_id, user_id, caller.user.id)
+    except enterprise_sso.EnterpriseSSOError as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(404, str(exc)) from exc
+    return {"restored": user_id}
+
+
+@router.post("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/checkout")
+async def sso_checkout(org_id: int, body: CheckoutIn, request: Request,
+                       caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    if not _same_origin(request):
+        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-origin request rejected")
+    try:
+        return await enterprise_billing.start_checkout(org_id, body.plan, price_id=body.price_id,
+            base=_return_base(request), email=caller.email)
+    except enterprise_billing.EnterpriseBillingError as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(422, str(exc)) from exc
+
+
+@router.post("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/setup/{intent}")
+async def sso_setup(org_id: int, intent: str, request: Request,
+                    caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    if not _same_origin(request):
+        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-origin request rejected")
+    settings = get_settings()
+    if not settings.workos_api_key:
+        raise HTTPException(503, "WorkOS is not configured")
+    try:
+        org, config = await enterprise_sso.configured_team(org_id)
+        if intent not in {"sso", "dsync"} or (intent == "dsync" and config.plan != "sso_directory"):
+            raise HTTPException(422, "setup option is unavailable")
+        workos_org_id = config.workos_org_id
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
+            if not workos_org_id:
+                workos_org_id = await workos.create_organization(client,
+                    key=settings.workos_api_key, name=org.name, org_id=org_id)
+                await enterprise_sso.bind_workos_org(org_id, workos_org_id)
+            link = await workos.portal_link(client, key=settings.workos_api_key,
+                organization=workos_org_id, intent=intent,
+                return_url=settings.public_url.rstrip("/") + "/app#sso")
+        await enterprise_sso.record_action(org_id, "sso.setup_link_generated", actor=caller.user.id)
+        return {"url": link}
+    except (enterprise_sso.EnterpriseSSOError, workos.WorkOSError) as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(422, str(exc)) from exc
+
+
+@router.post("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/invite-it")
+async def sso_invite_it(org_id: int, body: ITContactIn, request: Request,
+                        caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    if not _same_origin(request):
+        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-origin request rejected")
+    email = body.email.strip().lower()
+    if len(email) > 254 or email.count("@") != 1 or not email.split("@", 1)[0] or "." not in email.rsplit("@", 1)[1]:
+        raise HTTPException(422, "enter the IT admin's email")
+    settings = get_settings()
+    if not settings.workos_api_key:
+        raise HTTPException(503, "WorkOS is not configured")
+    try:
+        org, config = await enterprise_sso.configured_team(org_id)
+        workos_org_id = config.workos_org_id
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
+            if not workos_org_id:
+                workos_org_id = await workos.create_organization(client,
+                    key=settings.workos_api_key, name=org.name, org_id=org_id)
+                await enterprise_sso.bind_workos_org(org_id, workos_org_id)
+            await workos.invite_it_contact(client, key=settings.workos_api_key,
+                organization=workos_org_id, email=email,
+                directory_sync=config.plan == "sso_directory")
+        await enterprise_sso.record_action(org_id, "sso.it_contact_invited", actor=caller.user.id)
+        return {"invited": True}
+    except (enterprise_sso.EnterpriseSSOError, workos.WorkOSError) as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(422, str(exc)) from exc
+
+
+@router.get("/auth/sso/idp/start")
+async def sso_idp_start(request: Request, connection_id: str = ""):
+    """An Okta app tile supplies a connection hint, then starts our normal checked flow."""
+    if not connection_id or len(connection_id) > 100:
+        raise HTTPException(404, "company sign-in not found")
+    async with session_maker() as db:
+        config = (await db.execute(select(EnterpriseSSO).where(
+            EnterpriseSSO.connection_id == connection_id,
+            EnterpriseSSO.subscription_status.in_(("active", "trialing")),
+        ))).scalar_one_or_none()
+        org = await db.get(Org, config.org_id) if config else None
+        if org is None or org.suspended:
+            raise HTTPException(404, "company sign-in not found")
+        slug = org.slug
+    return await sso_start(slug, request)
+
+
+@router.get("/auth/sso/{org_slug}/start")
+async def sso_start(org_slug: str, request: Request):
+    settings = get_settings()
+    if not settings.workos_api_key or not settings.workos_client_id:
+        raise HTTPException(503, "SSO is not configured")
+    async with session_maker() as db:
+        org = (await db.execute(select(Org).where(Org.slug == org_slug))).scalar_one_or_none()
+        if org is None:
+            raise HTTPException(404, "team not found")
+        org_id = org.id
+    try:
+        _, config = await enterprise_sso.configured_team(org_id)
+    except enterprise_sso.EnterpriseSSOError as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(404, str(exc)) from exc
+    if not config.workos_org_id:
+        raise HTTPException(409, "SSO setup is incomplete")
+    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    cookie = crypto.encrypt(json.dumps({"org_id": org_id, "slug": org_slug, "nonce": nonce,
+                                        "expires": int(time.time()) + 600}))
+    callback = settings.public_url.rstrip("/") + "/auth/sso/callback"
+    url = workos.authorization_url(client_id=settings.workos_client_id,
+        organization=config.workos_org_id, redirect_uri=callback, state=nonce)
+    response = RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)
+    response.set_cookie(STATE_COOKIE, cookie, httponly=True, secure=_is_https(request),
+                        samesite="lax", max_age=600)
+    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
+    return response
+
+
+@router.post("/auth/sso/discover")
+async def sso_discover(body: DiscoverIn, request: Request) -> dict:
+    """Email routes a visitor to a connection; only the WorkOS callback can grant access."""
+    email = body.email.strip().lower()
+    if len(email) > 254 or email.count("@") != 1 or not email.split("@", 1)[0]:
+        raise HTTPException(422, "enter a valid work email")
+    domain = email.rsplit("@", 1)[1].strip(".")
+    if not domain or "." not in domain or len(domain) > 253:
+        raise HTTPException(422, "enter a valid work email")
+    async with session_maker() as db:
+        await ratestore.sweep(db, "sso_discover")
+        allowed = await ratestore.rate_check(db, "sso_discover",
+            [(f"ip:{client_ip.of(request)}", 30)], 900)
+        await db.commit()
+    if not allowed:
+        raise HTTPException(429, "too many sign-in lookups; try again later")
+    settings = get_settings()
+    if not settings.workos_api_key:
+        raise HTTPException(503, "company sign-in is unavailable")
+    try:
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
+            organizations = await workos.verified_organizations_for_domain(client,
+                key=settings.workos_api_key, domain=domain)
+    except workos.WorkOSError as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(503, "company sign-in is temporarily unavailable") from exc
+    organization_ids = {item.get("id") for item in organizations}
+    if not organization_ids:
+        return {"teams": []}
+    async with session_maker() as db:
+        matches = (await db.execute(select(Org, EnterpriseSSO).join(
+            EnterpriseSSO, EnterpriseSSO.org_id == Org.id).where(
+                EnterpriseSSO.workos_org_id.in_(organization_ids),
+                EnterpriseSSO.subscription_status.in_(("active", "trialing")),
+                Org.suspended.is_(False),
+        ))).all()
+    return {"teams": sorted(({"name": org.name, "slug": org.slug}
+        for org, _ in matches), key=lambda team: (team["name"].lower(), team["slug"]))}
+
+
+@router.get("/auth/sso/callback")
+async def sso_callback(request: Request, code: str = "", state: str = "", error: str = ""):
+    cookie = request.cookies.get(STATE_COOKIE, "")
+    try:
+        saved = json.loads(crypto.decrypt(cookie))
+        if not state or not secrets.compare_digest(state, saved["nonce"]):
+            raise ValueError("state")
+        if int(saved["expires"]) < time.time():
+            raise ValueError("expired")
+        org_id = int(saved["org_id"])
+    except (InvalidToken, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return _signin_failure("expired")
+    if not code:
+        await enterprise_sso.record_action(org_id, "sso.signin_failed")
+        return _signin_failure(
+            "domain" if error == "profile_not_allowed_outside_organization" else "failed",
+            saved.get("slug", ""),
+        )
+    settings = get_settings()
+    try:
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
+            profile = await workos.exchange_code(client, key=settings.workos_api_key,
+                                                 client_id=settings.workos_client_id, code=code)
+            organization = await workos.get_organization(client, key=settings.workos_api_key,
+                                                         organization=profile.get("organization_id", ""))
+        original = identity_session.read_session_claims(request.cookies.get(identity_session.COOKIE, ""))
+        proven_user_id = None
+        if original is not None and original.get("sso_org_id") is None:
+            async with session_maker() as db:
+                user = await _user_from_session(request.cookies.get(identity_session.COOKIE, ""), db)
+                proven_user_id = user.id if user is not None else None
+        result = await enterprise_sso.finish_signin(org_id, profile, organization=organization,
+                                                    proven_user_id=proven_user_id)
+    except enterprise_sso.EnterpriseSSOError as exc:
+        await enterprise_sso.record_action(org_id, "sso.signin_failed")
+        reason = "link" if "sign in to your existing treg account" in str(exc) else "failed"
+        return _signin_failure(reason, saved.get("slug", ""))
+    except workos.WorkOSError:
+        await enterprise_sso.record_action(org_id, "sso.signin_failed")
+        return _signin_failure("failed", saved.get("slug", ""))
+    response = RedirectResponse("/app?sso=success", status_code=303)
+    response.delete_cookie(STATE_COOKIE)
+    response.set_cookie(identity_session.COOKIE,
+        identity_session.make_session(result.user_id, token_version=result.token_version,
+                                      sso_org_id=result.org_id),
+        httponly=True, secure=_is_https(request), samesite="lax",
+        max_age=identity_session.TTL_SECONDS)
+    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
+    return response
+
+
+@router.post("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/enforce")
+async def sso_enforce(org_id: int, body: EnforceIn, request: Request,
+                      caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    if not _same_origin(request):
+        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-origin request rejected")
+    try:
+        return {"enforced": await enterprise_sso.set_enforced(org_id, body.enabled, caller.user.id)}
+    except enterprise_sso.EnterpriseSSOError as exc:
+        raise HTTPException(422, str(exc)) from exc
+
+
+@router.post("/orgs/{org_id}/sso/cancel")
+async def sso_cancel(org_id: int, request: Request,
+                     caller: Caller = Depends(require_member)) -> dict:
+    _owner(caller, org_id)
+    if not _same_origin(request):
+        raise HTTPException(403, "cross-origin request rejected")

+"""Migration keeps earlier manual removals when WorkOS identity rows are retired."""

+from importlib import import_module
+
+from alembic.migration import MigrationContext
+from alembic.operations import Operations
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

+def test_existing_manual_removals_are_backfilled(monkeypatch):
+    migration = import_module("treg.alembic.versions.0085_enterprise_sso_blocks")
+    engine = create_engine("sqlite://")
+    with engine.begin() as connection:
+        connection.execute(text("CREATE TABLE org (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)"))
+        connection.execute(text("CREATE TABLE user (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)"))
+        connection.execute(text("""CREATE TABLE enterprisessoidentity (
+            org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, manually_blocked BOOLEAN NOT NULL)"""))
+        connection.execute(text("INSERT INTO org (id) VALUES (1)"))
+        connection.execute(text("INSERT INTO user (id) VALUES (10), (11)"))
+        connection.execute(text("""INSERT INTO enterprisessoidentity
+            (org_id, user_id, manually_blocked) VALUES (1, 10, 1), (1, 11, 0)"""))
+        monkeypatch.setattr(migration, "op", Operations(MigrationContext.configure(connection)))
+        migration.upgrade()

+/**
+ * 红队证据账本（活学活用 REA 的 Evidence 思想，不是照抄）
+ *
+ * rea 的 Evidence 是给"静态分析结论"做内容寻址的——observed/derived/inferred
+ * 三档置信度，每条结论带 SHA-256 语义哈希。
+ *
+ * 这里改成红队语义：
+ * · `claimed`   = 子智能体口头报告的"我拿到了"——红色词，指挥智能体绝不能直接信
+ * · `observed`  = 实际工具回显/数据库记录证实的——指挥智能体核对后采信
+ * · `derived`   = 从 observed 证据推理出来的
+ * · `inferred`  = 子智能体/指挥智能体的推测，必须标注
+ *
+ * 每条 evidence 有 `ev_id = "ev_" + sha256(规范化语义)`——同一内容哈希必同，
+ * 改一字哈希就变，落库时可验"子智能体说 A、库里记的是不是真的 A"。
+ *
+ * ResidualUnknown 从 rea 学来但改语义：rea 用来记"分析覆盖不到的未知"，
+ * 这里记"红队作战里还**没打完、证据还不足**的问题"——比如"这台内网机器的
+ * 22 端口可能是 SSH 但还没试出凭据"。
+ *
+ * 本模块零依赖，只依赖 Node 内建 crypto/sqlite。不依赖任何 Cordis 服务。
+ */
+
+import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
+import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
+
+/* ── 置信度与权威枚举 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
+
+export const EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE = ['claimed', 'observed', 'derived', 'inferred']
+
+export const EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY = [
+  'tool-output',      // 直接工具回显（nmap/fscan/curl 原始输出）
+  'database-record',  // 库里已有的行（SELECT 查出来的）
+  'screenshot',       // 现场截图
+  'request-replay',   // HTTP 原始请求重放成功
+  'subagent-report',  // 子智能体回报（= claimed，必须核对）
+  'operator-input',   // 用户/操作者提供
+]
+
+/** 子智能体回报必须经过核实才能从 claimed 升级为 observed */
+export const CONFIDENCE_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION = new Set(['claimed', 'inferred'])
+
+/* ── 哈希工具 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
+
+/** 规范化 JSON：键按码点排序，确保语义相同哈希必同 */
+const canonicalize = (value) => {
+  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') return JSON.stringify(value)
+  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonicalize).join(',')}]`
+  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort()
+  return `{${keys.map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalize(value[k])}`).join(',')}}`
+}
+
+/** 计算 evidence 的语义哈希，返回 "ev_" 前缀的 hex digest */
+export const evidenceId = (semantic) => {
+  const canonical = canonicalize(semantic)
+  return 'ev_' + createHash('sha256').update(canonical, 'utf8').digest('hex')
+}

+/* ── Evidence DDL（独立的表，不动现有 schema）─────────────────────────── */
+
+export const EVIDENCE_LEDGER_DDL = `
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evidence (
+  ev_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  confidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('claimed','observed','derived','inferred')),
+  authority TEXT NOT NULL,
+  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
+  parameters TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+  result TEXT NOT NULL,
+  raw_ref TEXT,
+  limitations TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
+  supporting_ev_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
+  recorded_by TEXT,
+  recorded_at TEXT,
+  source_agent TEXT,
+  engagement_id TEXT
+);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_evidence_operation ON evidence(operation);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_evidence_confidence ON evidence(confidence);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_evidence_engagement ON evidence(engagement_id);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS residual_unknown (
+  unk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
+  question TEXT NOT NULL,
+  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
+    CHECK(status IN ('open','investigating','blocked','contradicted','resolved')),
+  severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium'
+    CHECK(severity IN ('low','medium','high','critical')),
+  domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
+  scope_digest TEXT,
+  supporting_ev_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
+  contradicting_ev_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
+  required_authority TEXT,
+  required_confidence TEXT,
+  recommended_probe TEXT,
+  resolution TEXT,
+  recorded_by TEXT,
+  recorded_at TEXT,
+  resolved_at TEXT,
+  engagement_id TEXT
+);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_unknown_status ON residual_unknown(status);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_unknown_engagement ON residual_unknown(engagement_id);
+`

+/* ── EvidenceLedger 类 ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

+/**
+ * 挂载在某靶标 SQLite 句柄上的证据账本。
+ *
+ * 用法：
+ *   import { EvidenceLedger, EVIDENCE_LEDGER_DDL } from './evidence-ledger.mjs'
+ *   const ledger = new EvidenceLedger(db)   // db 是靶标数据库的 DatabaseSync 句柄
+ *   ledger.record({ operation: 'nmap_scan', result: {...}, ... })
+ *
+ * 不自己 open/close 数据库，避免双重所有权；由 RedteamStore.db() 管理的句柄传入。
+ */
+export class EvidenceLedger {
+  /** @param db DatabaseSync 句柄（已打开、已 migrate） */
+  constructor(db) {
+    this.db = db
+    this.db.exec(EVIDENCE_LEDGER_DDL)
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * 记录一条 evidence。
+   *
+   * @param {object} input
+   * @param {string} input.operation       操作名（如 "nmap_scan"、"suo5_tunnel_established"）
+   * @param {object} input.parameters      调用参数（会规范化后参与哈希）
+   * @param {object} input.result          规范化结果（会参与哈希）
+   * @param {string} [input.confidence]    默认 'observed'
+   * @param {string} [input.authority]     默认 'tool-output'
+   * @param {string[]} [input.limitations] 默认 []
+   * @param {string[]} [input.supporting_ev_ids] 默认 []
+   * @param {string} [input.recorded_by]   谁记的（指挥智能体/子角色名）
+   * @param {string} [input.source_agent]  哪个子智能体产出的
+   * @param {string} [input.engagement_id] 靶标 id
+   *
+   * @returns {{ok:true, ev_id:string, duplicate:boolean}|{ok:false, error:string}}
+   */
+  record(input) {
+    const {
+      operation,
+      parameters = {},
+      result,
+      confidence = 'observed',
+      authority = 'tool-output',
+      limitations = [],
+      supporting_ev_ids = [],
+      recorded_by,
+      source_agent,
+      engagement_id,
+      raw_ref,
+    } = input
+
+    if (!operation || typeof operation !== 'string') {
+      return { ok: false, error: 'operation is required and must be a string' }
+    }
+    if (result === undefined || result === null) {
+      return { ok: false, error: 'result is required' }
+    }
+    if (!EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE.includes(confidence)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `confidence must be one of ${EVIDENCE_CONFIDENCE.join(',')}` }
+    }
+    if (!EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY.includes(authority)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `authority must be one of ${EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY.join(',')}` }
+    }
+
+    const semantic = {
+      operation,
+      parameters: sanitizeForHash(parameters),
+      result: sanitizeForHash(result),
+      confidence,
+      authority,
+      limitations,
+      supporting_ev_ids: [...supporting_ev_ids].sort(),
+    }
+    const ev_id = evidenceId(semantic)
+
+    try {
+      const existing = this.db
+        .prepare('SELECT ev_id FROM evidence WHERE ev_id = ?')
+        .get(ev_id)
+      if (existing) return { ok: true, ev_id, duplicate: true }
+
+      this.db
+        .prepare(
+          `INSERT INTO evidence
+           (ev_id, confidence, authority, operation, parameters, result,
+            raw_ref, limitations, supporting_ev_ids,
+            recorded_by, recorded_at, source_agent, engagement_id)
+           VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
+        )
+        .run(
+          ev_id,
+          confidence,
+          authority,
+          operation,
+          JSON.stringify(parameters),
+          JSON.stringify(result),
+          raw_ref ?? null,
+          JSON.stringify(limitations),
+          JSON.stringify(supporting_ev_ids),
+          recorded_by ?? null,
+          new Date().toISOString(),
+          source_agent ?? null,
+          engagement_id ?? null,
+        )

+    } catch (err) {
+      return { ok: false, error: String(err.message ?? err) }
+    }
+  }

+  /** 按 ev_id 取一条 evidence（已解析 JSON 字段） */
+  get(ev_id) {

+      const row = this.db

+        .get(ev_id)
+      if (!row) return undefined
+      return parseEvidenceRow(row)
+    } catch {
+      return undefined
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * 核对：子智能体说"我做了 X 得到 Y"，指挥智能体用此验证。
+   * 返回 { matched: true } 或 { matched: false, expected_ev_id, actual_ev_id }
+   */
+  verify(input) {
+    const { operation, parameters = {}, result, confidence = 'observed', authority = 'tool-output', limitations = [], supporting_ev_ids = [] } = input
+    const semantic = {
+      operation,
+      parameters: sanitizeForHash(parameters),
+      result: sanitizeForHash(result),
+      confidence,
+      authority,
+      limitations,
+      supporting_ev_ids: [...supporting_ev_ids].sort(),
+    }

+    const found = this.get(expected_ev_id)

+      ? { matched: true, ev_id: expected_ev_id }

+  }

+  /**
+   * 把 claimed / inferred 升级为 observed。
+   * 红队场景：子智能体回报 webshell 已上线（claimed），指挥智能体 curl 实测后升级。
+   *
+   * @returns {{ok:true, ev_id:string}|{ok:false, error:string}}
+   */

+    if (existing.confidence === 'observed') return { ok: true, ev_id: claimed_ev_id }
+    if (!CONFIDENCE_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION.has(existing.confidence)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `confidence '${existing.confidence}' does not require upgrade` }
+    }

+    // existing 已是 parseEvidenceRow 处理过的行：JSON 字段已是对象，勿二次 parse。
+    return this.record({
+      operation: existing.operation,
+      parameters: existing.parameters,
+      result: verified_result ?? existing.result,
+      confidence: 'observed',
+      authority: existing.authority === 'subagent-report' ? 'tool-output' : existing.authority,
+      limitations: existing.limitations,
+      supporting_ev_ids: [...existing.supporting_ev_ids, claimed_ev_id],
+      recorded_by: verified_by ?? 'coordinator',
+      source_agent: existing.source_agent,
+      engagement_id: existing.engagement_id,

+  }

+  list(filter = {}) {

+    const conditions = []
+    const params = []
+    if (operation) { conditions.push('operation = ?'); params.push(operation) }
+    if (confidence) { conditions.push('confidence = ?'); params.push(confidence) }
+    if (engagement_id) { conditions.push('engagement_id = ?'); params.push(engagement_id) }

+      return { error: String(err.message ?? err) }
+    }
+  }

+  /**
+   * 账本里 claimed / inferred 的**总条数**（含已核实闭环的）。

+name: paper-autopilot
+description: |
+  论文全自动流水线（单技能，自带流程引擎、检索核验、数据溯源、成品构建脚本，不依赖其它技能）。
+  给一句话方向，按 22 步自动走完「选题—检索—核验—证据—框架—数据—图表—写作—去AI痕迹—选刊/格式—投稿或答辩—交付」，
+  全程不向用户提问，进度落盘可跨会话续跑。两种模式：SCI 英文期刊（IMRaD）与中文论文/学位论文
+  （本科/硕士/博士/课程/开题，GB/T 7714 顺序编码制 + Word/PDF 成品）。
+  触发词：写论文、帮我写论文、毕业论文、学位论文、本科论文、硕士论文、博士论文、课程论文、开题报告、
+  写一篇SCI、全自动写论文、自动走完流程、接着上次的论文继续、论文进度、查文献、核验引用、排参考文献、
+  生成Word/PDF、答辩PPT、检查能不能交、去AI味、润色、选刊、投稿、返修、答复信。
+  English: write a paper, write a thesis, dissertation, manuscript, run the paper pipeline,

+
+# 论文全自动流水线 · paper-autopilot
+
+一句话方向进，成品出来。中文项目走中文成品层（Word/PDF + GB/T 7714），英文项目走 SCI 层（LaTeX/投稿包）。
+
+## 开工判据（先判模式，再敲命令）
+
+| 用户说的是 | 模式 | 第一条命令 |
+|---|---|---|
+| 毕业论文 / 学位论文 / 本科 / 硕士 / 博士 / 课程论文 / 开题报告 | **CN 模式**（默认） | `scaffold.py` 建骨架 → 再 `autopilot.py start` |
+| SCI / 期刊 / 英文 / 投稿 / 影响因子 | **SCI 模式** | `autopilot.py start --direction "<方向>"` |
+| 接着上次继续 / 进度到哪了 | **续跑** | 读 `PIPELINE.md` + `PAPER_STATE.json` → `autopilot.py status` |

+模式只影响第 09–21 步的产出形态；第 00–08 步（选题、检索、证据）两种模式完全一致。

+## 五条铁律
+
+1. **不编数据、不编文献。** 数字必须能追到 `data/` 或代码；引用必须真检索、真核验。查不到写"未验证"，不补一个像真的。
+2. **每步过闸。** `autopilot.py done` 会核查产出是否真存在且非空，缺文件拒绝前进。过不了闸就回头改，不带着问题往下走。
+3. **不停下来提问。** 本该问用户的事，改成：自己选一个能自圆其说的 → 记进 `DECISIONS.md` → 继续。唯一允许停的三种情况见 `references/autopilot_contract.md`。
+4. **去 AI 终检（第 19 步）必须排在投稿前总检（第 20 步）之前。** 终检会改句子，改句子会动数字、引用、图表号；先检后改等于检了一份不投的稿。
+5. **降级可以，隐瞒不行。** 走不通的步子用 `skip --reason` 留痕，`selfcheck.py` 会查它有没有写进最终交付说明。没写＝阻断项。
+
+## 主循环（三个命令）
+
+```bash
+PY=<带 requests/matplotlib/python-docx 的解释器>     # 见下节「依赖」
+SK=<本技能目录>
+
+python $SK/scripts/autopilot.py start --dir <项目目录> --direction "<方向或题目>"
+python $SK/scripts/autopilot.py next  --dir <项目目录>   # 打印本步工单：产出路径 + 通过标准 + 该读哪份参考
+python $SK/scripts/autopilot.py done  --dir <项目目录>   # 交工，核查产出后前进
+```
+
+`start` 自动定下刊/分区/篇幅/图表数/参考文献上限/论文类型/有无实验数据/作者占位符，全部记进 `DECISIONS.md`，事后可改。
+`next` 的工单是**唯一权威指令**：照着做，不要自己想下一步做什么。
+辅助：`skip`（降级留痕）、`decide`（记决策）、`check`（核对已完步骤产出）、`status`（完整进度）。
+
+**降级必须留痕**：
+
+```bash
+python $SK/scripts/autopilot.py skip --dir <项目目录> --step 04 --reason "<为什么做不了>"
+```

+## CN 模式成品层（六条命令）
+
+```bash
+python $SK/scripts/scaffold.py   --dir <项目目录> --title "论文题目" --type 本科
+python $SK/scripts/figure_kit.py --data <数据.csv> --spec <图定义.json> --out figures/

+
+这里放的是**脚手架模板**和**一个跑通的真实案例**。技能本体（`references/` + `scripts/`）
+是可复用的方法；`assets/` 是"照这个样子开工"的起点和"这样算做完了"的样本。
+
+```
+assets/
+├── BRIEF.md.tpl                   第 01 步：把 SCI 默认值改写成学位论文口径的那张表
+├── PIPELINE.md.tpl                人可读进度真源（差异表 / 总检结果 / 未达标项 / 校准记录）
+├── PAPER_STATE.json.tpl           机器可读状态（22 步骨架 + gates + decisions）
+├── DECISIONS.md.tpl               自动决策记录（D 段流水线决定 / U 段只能用户决定）
+└── case_3dprint_lattice/          真实案例：3D 打印点阵结构本科毕业论文
+    ├── README.md                  这个案例是什么、结果如何、哪些数字可复用
+    ├── PIPELINE.md                案例交付时的原文件（22/22）
+    ├── DECISIONS.md               案例的 10 条决策 + 4 条用户决策
+    └── code/                      20 个项目专用脚本（含硬编码单项目版）
+```
+
+## 怎么用
+
+1. **开工**：跑 `scripts/scaffold.py --dir <项目> --title "<题目>" --type 本科`，
+   它按 `BRIEF.md.tpl` / `PAPER_STATE.json.tpl` / `DECISIONS.md.tpl` 的结构生成骨架；
+   也可以手工拷模板再替换 `<尖括号>` 占位符。
+2. **对照**：走到某一步拿不准产出物长什么样，去看 `case_3dprint_lattice/` 里对应的原文件。
+3. **别照抄数字**：案例里的数值属于那个题目、那个模型、那批文献。可复用的是
+   **结构、口径、检查项、事故清单**；不可复用的是具体参数与结论。
+
+## 两个容易踩的坑
+
+- `.tpl` 里的占位符用 `<尖括号>` 包住，**不要留在交付稿里**。
+  `scripts/selfcheck.py` 会扫占位符残留，`final_check.py` 会扫 `〔待填：…〕`。
+- `PAPER_STATE.json.tpl` 是纯 JSON，**不能加注释**（JSON 不认）。说明写在 `_note` 键里。
+
+## 与 `scripts/` 的关系
+
+`assets/case_3dprint_lattice/code/` 里同名的 `build_docx.py`、`final_check.py`、
+`math2unicode.py`、`docx_to_pdf.py`、`wordcount.py` 是**硬编码单项目版**：
+路径写死在 `Desktop\毕业论文` 下，只服务那一个项目。技能包 `scripts/` 下的是**参数化版**
+（`Cfg` 类 + CLI 参数），两者不要互相覆盖。要用通用能力，用 `scripts/`；要学"当年怎么写死的"，看案例。

+- **理由**：在无实验条件下，有限元的材料参数同样需要文献标定，并不比半解析模型更"真实"；而半解析模型的计算可完整复现、参数物理含义清晰、便于做 3000 组拉丁超立方抽样。若用有限元，不确定性传播的计算量将上升两个数量级

+## 三、哪些可以复用到别的题目
+
+**可以照搬（结构与方法）**

+  `sync_numbers.py`（表格）+ `sync_inline_numbers.py`（行内）都要求唯一匹配，宁可不改也不能误改。
+- 引用编号由脚本生成 + 逐条审计（`check_citations.py`），手工维护必然错位。
+- 无实验数据的声明话术：在摘要、1.4、4.9、5.2、附录 B.4 共五处声明，而不是"很遗憾没做实验"。
+
+**不能照搬（属于这个题目）**
+
+- Gibson–Ashby 的具体标定系数、β = 150、ε_D = clamp(1−1.4ρ̄, 0.45, 0.88)——
+  这些是"这个模型在这批文献下的取值"，换材料体系要重新标定。
+- 上述任何一个数字。它们只在 18 条曲线 × 320 点、138 设计点这一套数据下成立。
+- 12 图 / 17 表的具体切分：换题目后图表预算要按第 09 步的 OUTLINE 重算。
+
+## 四、这个案例留下的三个"反面教材"
+
+1. **BRIEF 的预算与实际不符**：第 01 步写的是"12 图 + 6 表、参考文献 40–50 条、字数 ≥18,000"，
+   交付时是"12 图 + **17 表**、**47+54** 条、**23,181** 字"。表数量涨了近三倍，因为设计点与
+   统计量太多，表比图更能承载。**教训：图表预算在第 09 步按 OUTLINE 重新确认一次，别让第 01 步的数字
+   一路错到交付。**
+2. **一次性修补脚本写了 6 个**（`fix_table41.py`、`fix_table45.py`、`fix_layer_section.py`、
+   `fix_rsm_inline.py`、`fix_angle_para.py`、`sync_inline_numbers.py`）。这是"模型改了、正文没跟上"
+   的直接代价。**教训：数字一律由脚本从 `data/` 回填，正文里不手写数字，这类脚本一个都不该存在。**
+3. **`PIPELINE.md` 与 `PAPER_STATE.json` 的时间戳互相矛盾**（日志里 20 步 14:57 通过，
+   15:20 又因全链路校准重跑了一次）。**教训：校准后要重写"总检结果"和"校准记录"两张表，
+   否则下一次接手的人会以为 14:57 那份是终版。**
+
+## 五、`code/` 里有什么
+
+20 个脚本，全部是**硬编码单项目版**（路径写死在项目根）。它们不是技能包的主版本，
+主版本在 `scripts/`（参数化 + CLI）。这里保留是为了回答"当年这活儿具体怎么干的"。

+| `fix_*.py` | 一次性校准修补（反面教材，见第四节） |

+        parts = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"[;；]", raw) if p.strip()]

+        parts = [p.strip() for p in raw.split(",") if p.strip()]
+    if len(parts) > 3:
+        return ", ".join(parts[:3]) + ", 等"
+    return ", ".join(parts)
+
+
+_VOLPAGE = re.compile(r"v(\d+)\s*i?(\d*)\s*(?:p([\d\-–]+))?")
+_BRACKET = re.compile(r"(\d+)\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*:\s*([\d\-–]+)")
+
+
+def parse_volpage(note: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    if not isinstance(note, str):
+        return "", ""
+    m = _BRACKET.search(note)          # 形如 "9(24): 1485-1510"
+    if m:
+        return m.group(1), m.group(3).replace("–", "-")
+    m = _VOLPAGE.search(note)          # 形如 "v113 i8" / "v99 p225-239"
+    if m:
+        return (m.group(1) or ""), (m.group(3) or "").replace("–", "-")
+    return "", ""
+
+
+def fmt_year(year) -> str:
+    """年份字段可能被写成非数字（如"未核实"），需容错。"""
+    if pd.isna(year):
+        return "s.a."
+    s = str(year).strip()
+    if not s:
+        return "s.a."
+    try:
+        return str(int(float(s)))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return s
+
+
+def fmt_one(r: pd.Series, idx: int) -> str:
+    authors = fmt_authors(r.get("作者", ""))
+    title = str(r.get("标题", "")).strip().rstrip(".")
+    journal = str(r.get("期刊", "")).strip()
+    doi = str(r.get("DOI", "")).strip()
+    typ = str(r.get("类型", "journal")).strip()
+    vol, page = parse_volpage(r.get("备注", ""))
+    year_s = fmt_year(r.get("年份", ""))
+
+    if typ == "standard":
+        s = f"[{idx}] {authors}. {title}[S]. {year_s}."
+    elif typ == "book":
+        s = f"[{idx}] {authors}. {title}[M]. {year_s}."
+    elif typ == "thesis":
+        s = f"[{idx}] {authors}. {title}[D]. {year_s}."
+    else:
+        s = f"[{idx}] {authors}. {title}[J]. {journal}, {year_s}"
+        if vol:
+            s += f", {vol}"
+        if page:
+            s += f": {page}"
+        s += "."
+    if doi and doi.lower() not in ("nan", "none", ""):
+        s += f" DOI: {doi}."
+    return s
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="只列出编号与简化信息")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    df = pd.read_csv(SEL, encoding="utf-8-sig").set_index("id", drop=False)
+    missing = [i for i in CITATION_ORDER if i not in df.index]
+    if missing:
+        print(f"!! 以下 id 不在 SELECTION.csv 中：{missing}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+    ordered = [i for i in CITATION_ORDER if i in df.index]
+    if args.list:
+        for n, i in enumerate(ordered, 1):
+            r = df.loc[i]
+            print(f"[{n:>2}] {i} | {r['年份']} | {str(r['作者'])[:34]:34s} | {str(r['标题'])[:66]}")
+        print(f"\n共 {len(ordered)} 条进入引用顺序")
+        return 0
+
+    # 未进入引用顺序的文献：作为"延伸阅读"，按年份降序
+    rest = [i for i in df.index if i not in set(ordered)]
+    rest_df = df.loc[rest].copy()
+    rest_df["_y"] = pd.to_numeric(rest_df["年份"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
+    rest_df = rest_df.sort_values("_y", ascending=False)
+
+    lines = ["## 参考文献", "",
+             f"（按 GB/T 7714—2015 顺序编码制编排，共 {len(ordered)} 条）", ""]
+    for n, i in enumerate(ordered, 1):
+        lines.append(fmt_one(df.loc[i], n))
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append(f"### 延伸阅读（正文未直接引用，共 {len(rest)} 条，供进一步查阅）")
+    lines.append("")
+    for r_i, (i, r) in enumerate(rest_df.iterrows(), start=1):
+        lines.append("E" + str(r_i) + ". " + fmt_one(r, 0).split("] ", 1)[-1])
+    lines += ["",
+              "> 本表由 `code/build_references_ordered.py` 从 "
+              "`06_文献筛选分类/SELECTION.csv` 自动生成。"
+              "全部 DOI 均由检索阶段与选题阶段通过 Crossref API 逐条核实。", ""]
+
+    (OUT / "参考文献.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(f"已生成 {OUT / '参考文献.md'}：正文引用 {len(ordered)} 条 + 延伸阅读 {len(rest)} 条")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""参考文献引用一致性校验（第 20 步总检用）。
+
+检查三件事：
+  1. 正文里出现的每个 [n] 是否都能在参考文献表中找到编号 n；
+  2. 参考文献表中每个编号是否在正文被引用（未被引用的列出为"孤立条目"）；
+  3. 抽样打印若干条"正文上下文 ↔ 参考条目"，供人工判断引用是否指向正确文献。
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+if sys.platform == "win32":
+    try:
+        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+MAN = ROOT / "manuscript"
+REFS = ROOT / "05_稿件" / "参考文献.md"
+
+CITE = re.compile(r"\[(\d+(?:\s*[,，\-–]\s*\d+)*)\]")
+
+
+def expand(token: str) -> set[int]:
+    """展开 '[3,6]' / '[3-5]' 形式的引用号。"""
+    out: set[int] = set()
+    for part in re.split(r"[,，]", token):
+        part = part.strip()
+        m = re.match(r"^(\d+)\s*[-–]\s*(\d+)$", part)
+        if m:
+            out.update(range(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)) + 1))
+        elif part.isdigit():
+            out.add(int(part))
+    return out
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    text = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in sorted(MAN.glob("*.md")))
+    used: set[int] = set()
+    for m in CITE.finditer(text):
+        used |= expand(m.group(1))
+    used.discard(0)
+
+    ref_lines = [l for l in REFS.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+                 if re.match(r"^\[\d+\]", l)]
+    defined = {int(re.match(r"^\[(\d+)\]", l).group(1)) for l in ref_lines}
+    ref_map = {int(re.match(r"^\[(\d+)\]", l).group(1)): l for l in ref_lines}
+
+    print(f"正文引用号 {len(used)} 个；参考文献表 {len(defined)} 条")
+    dangling = sorted(used - defined)
+    orphan = sorted(i for i in defined - used if i <= max(defined))
+    print()
+    print("① 悬空引用（正文引了但表里没有）:", dangling if dangling else "无")
+    print("② 孤立条目（表里有但正文未引）:", orphan if orphan else "无")
+
+    print()
+    print("③ 抽样核验（正文上下文 -> 对应条目）")
+    print("=" * 78)
+    # 取正文中出现频次较高的引用号做抽样
+    freq: dict[int, int] = {}
+    for m in CITE.finditer(text):
+        for n in expand(m.group(1)):
+            if n:
+                freq[n] = freq.get(n, 0) + 1
+    for n in sorted(freq, key=lambda k: -freq[k])[:14]:
+        # 找到第一次出现的上下文
+        m = re.search(r"[^。\n]{0,70}\[" + str(n) + r"(\D|$)", text)
+        ctx = (m.group(0) if m else "").strip().replace("\n", " ")
+        print(f"[{n}] 引用 {freq[n]} 次")
+        print(f"     正文: ...{ctx[-78:]}")
+        print(f"     条目: {ref_map.get(n, '(缺失)')[:110]}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""用 Word COM 把 docx 导出为 PDF（Word 未注册时回退到 WPS COM）。
+
+用法：
+    python code/docx_to_pdf.py [输入.docx] [输出.pdf]
+
+若不传参数，默认转换 deliverables/ 下的论文 docx。
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+if sys.platform == "win32":
+    for _s in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
+        try:
+            _s.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DELIV = ROOT / "deliverables"
+WD_FORMAT_PDF = 17
+
+CANDIDATES = ["Word.Application", "KWPS.Application", "WPS.Application"]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    src = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DELIV / "3D打印点阵结构本科毕业论文.docx"
+    dst = Path(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else src.with_suffix(".pdf")
+    if not src.exists():
+        print(f"找不到输入文件：{src}")
+        return 1
+
+    import win32com.client as win32  # 延迟导入，避免无 pywin32 时脚本不可读
+
+    last_err = None
+    for progid in CANDIDATES:
+        app = None
+        try:
+            print(f"尝试通过 {progid} 转换 ...")
+            app = win32.DispatchEx(progid)
+            try:
+                app.Visible = False
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            try:
+                app.DisplayAlerts = 0
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            doc = app.Documents.Open(str(src), ReadOnly=True, AddToRecentFiles=False)
+            try:
+                # 导出前尝试更新目录/页码域
+                try:
+                    doc.Fields.Update()
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+                try:
+                    for toc in doc.TablesOfContents:
+                        toc.Update()
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+                doc.SaveAs(str(dst), FileFormat=WD_FORMAT_PDF)
+            finally:
+                doc.Close(SaveChanges=False)
+            app.Quit()
+            if dst.exists() and dst.stat().st_size > 10_000:
+                print(f"已生成 PDF：{dst}")
+                print(f"  文件大小：{dst.stat().st_size / 1024:.0f} KB")
+                return 0
+            print(f"  {progid} 未产出有效 PDF，继续尝试下一个")
+        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
+            last_err = e
+            print(f"  {progid} 失败：{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+        finally:
+            try:
+                if app is not None:
+                    app.Quit()
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+    print(f"\n全部 COM 通道均失败。最后一次错误：{last_err}")
+    print("说明：本机 Word/WPS 未注册或不可用。可改用 PyMuPDF 渲染方案。")
+    return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""终检脚本（第 20 步）：一次性校验全部交付约束，输出总检报告。
+
+检查项：
+    1. 章节目录完整性（每个应有章节是否存在）
+    2. 正文字数
+    3. 图表数量与编号连续性、是否全部被正文引用
+    4. 参考文献：正文引用 vs 参考表条目（悬空 / 孤立）
+    5. 首字母/公式残留（LaTeX 命令、$ 符号）
+    6. 数据文件与交付文件的 SHA-256 哈希表
+    7. 作者占位符清单
+    8. 交付文件存在性与大小
+
+用法：
+    python code/final_check.py            # 控制台报告
+    python code/final_check.py --write    # 同时写出 deliverables/HASHES.txt 与 20_投稿前总检/CHECK_REPORT.md
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+if sys.platform == "win32":
+    for _s in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
+        try:
+            _s.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+MAN = ROOT / "manuscript"
+DATA = ROOT / "data"
+FIG = ROOT / "figures"
+DELIV = ROOT / "deliverables"
+REFS = ROOT / "05_稿件" / "参考文献.md"
+
+REQUIRED_SECTIONS = [
+    "第 1 章", "第 2 章", "第 3 章", "第 4 章", "第 5 章",
+    "参考文献", "致谢", "附录 A", "附录 B",
+]
+CITE = re.compile(r"\[(\d+(?:\s*[,，\-–]\s*\d+)*)\]")
+PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"〔待填：[^〕]*〕")
+
+results: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []
+
+
+def check(name: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
+    results.append((name, ok, detail))
+
+
+def read_all_manuscript() -> str:
+    """正文分章 + 参考文献表（参考文献单独成文件，必须一并纳入检查）。"""
+    txt = "\n\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in sorted(MAN.glob("*.md")))
+    if REFS.exists():
+        txt += "\n\n" + REFS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    return txt
+
+
+def docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
+    """读取 docx 的全部文本（用于检查成品是否有公式/占位符残留）。"""
+    try:
+        from docx import Document
+    except ImportError:
+        return ""
+    d = Document(str(path))
+    parts = [p.text for p in d.paragraphs]
+    for t in d.tables:
+        for row in t.rows:
+            for c in row.cells:
+                parts.append(c.text)
+    return "\n".join(parts)
+
+
+def expand(token: str) -> set[int]:
+    out: set[int] = set()
+    for part in re.split(r"[,，]", token):
+        part = part.strip()
+        m = re.match(r"^(\d+)\s*[-–]\s*(\d+)$", part)
+        if m:
+            out.update(range(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)) + 1))
+        elif part.isdigit():
+            out.add(int(part))
+    return out
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--write", action="store_true")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    text = read_all_manuscript()
+    full = text
+    refs_text = REFS.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if REFS.exists() else ""
+
+    # 1 章节
+    missing = [s for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS if s not in full]
+    check("章节完整性", not missing,
+          "全部章节齐备" if not missing else f"缺失：{missing}")
+
+    # 2 字数
+    cjk = len(re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]", full))
+    check("正文字数 ≥ 18000", cjk >= 18000, f"实际 {cjk} 中文字符")
+
+    # 3 图表
+    figs = re.findall(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\(figures/fig([\d\-]+)_", full)
+    tabs = re.findall(r"\*\*表 ([\d\-]+)", full)
+    fig_nums = [f.split("-")[1] for f in figs]
+    ch4 = [int(n) for f, n in zip(figs, fig_nums) if f.startswith("4-")]
+    contig = ch4 == list(range(1, len(ch4) + 1))
+    check("图编号连续（第4章）", contig, f"第4章图号 {ch4}")
+    tab_nums = sorted({t for t in tabs})
+    check("表数量 ≥ 10", len(tab_nums) >= 10, f"{len(tab_nums)} 张表")
+
+    # 图片文件存在（图文件名形如 fig4-1_应力应变曲线.png，用前缀匹配）
+    all_stems = [p.stem for p in FIG.glob("*.png")]
+    miss_img = [f for f in figs if not any(s.startswith(f"fig{f}_") for s in all_stems)]
+    check("图片文件存在", not miss_img,
+          f"缺失 {miss_img}" if miss_img else f"{len(figs)}/{len(figs)} 存在")
+
+    # 4 引用一致性
+    used: set[int] = set()
+    for m in CITE.finditer(full):
+        used |= expand(m.group(1))
+    used.discard(0)
+    defined = {int(m.group(1)) for m in
+               (re.match(r"^\[(\d+)\]", l) for l in refs_text.splitlines()) if m}
+    dangling = sorted(used - defined)
+    orphan = sorted(i for i in defined - used if i <= max(defined or {0}))
+    check("无悬空引用", not dangling, f"{dangling}" if dangling else "0 处")
+    check("无孤立条目", not orphan, f"{orphan}" if orphan else "0 条")
+
+    # 5 公式残留：md 源里出现 LaTeX 是正常的（那是唯一真源），
+    #    真正要检查的是**成品 docx** 里是否还有未转换的公式标记。
+    docx_path = DELIV / "3D打印点阵结构本科毕业论文.docx"
+    dtxt = docx_text(docx_path) if docx_path.exists() else ""
+    if dtxt:
+        d_dollar = dtxt.count("$")
+        # 只匹配真实 LaTeX 数学命令名；不能笼统匹配"反斜杠+字母"，
+        # 否则附录 B.3 里的 Windows 路径（D:\py\Python311\...）会被误判。
+        LATEX_CMDS = (r"\\(?:frac|tfrac|dfrac|sqrt|bar|hat|tilde|vec|mathrm|"
+                      r"mathbf|mathit|text|left|right|rho|sigma|theta|alpha|"
+                      r"beta|gamma|delta|varepsilon|epsilon|lambda|mu|eta|"
+                      r"kappa|chi|times|cdot|approx|leq|geq|infty|partial|"
+                      r"sum|int|tag|quad|qquad|begin|end|underbrace)\b")
+        d_latex = len(re.findall(LATEX_CMDS, dtxt))
+        code_bt = dtxt.count("```")
+        check("成品无公式残留（docx）",
+              d_dollar == 0 and d_latex == 0 and code_bt == 0,
+              f"$ 残留 {d_dollar}，LaTeX 命令残留 {d_latex}，代码围栏 {code_bt}")
+    else:
+        check("成品无公式残留（docx）", False, "无法读取 docx 文本")
+    # 同时记录 md 源的公式数量（供人工确认，不作为失败项）
+    src_dollar = full.count("$")
+    check("md 源公式标记（仅记录）", True, f"{src_dollar} 处 $ 标记，属正常（源用 LaTeX，成品已转换）")
+
+    # 6 交付文件
+    for f in ["3D打印点阵结构本科毕业论文.docx", "3D打印点阵结构本科毕业论文.pdf"]:
+        p = DELIV / f
+        ok = p.exists() and p.stat().st_size > 100_000
+        check(f"交付件 {f}", ok,
+              f"{p.stat().st_size/1024:.0f} KB" if p.exists() else "不存在")
+
+    # 7 占位符
+    ph = sorted(set(PLACEHOLDER.findall(full)))
+    check("作者占位符已集中标注", True, f"{len(ph)} 处待替换")
+
+    # 8 哈希表
+    hashes: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
+    for base in (DATA, FIG, DELIV):
+        for p in sorted(base.rglob("*")):
+            if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in (".csv", ".json", ".png", ".pdf", ".docx"):
+                h = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+                hashes.append((str(p.relative_to(ROOT)), h, p.stat().st_size))
+
+    # ---- 输出 ----
+    lines = ["# 第 20 步总检报告", "",
+             f"生成时间：2026-10-11　项目：{ROOT.name}", "",
+             "| 检查项 | 结果 | 说明 |", "|---|---|---|"]
+    npass = 0
+    for name, ok, detail in results:
+        npass += bool(ok)
+        lines.append(f"| {name} | {'✅ 通过' if ok else '❌ 未通过'} | {detail} |")
+    lines.append("")
+    lines.append(f"**{npass}/{len(results)} 项通过。**")
+    lines.append("")
+    if ph:
+        lines.append("## 待用户替换的占位符")
+        lines.append("")
+        for x in ph:
+            lines.append(f"- `{x}`")
+        lines.append("")
+
+    report = "\n".join(lines)
+    print(report)
+
+    if args.write:
+        outdir = ROOT / "20_投稿前总检"
+        outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        (outdir / "CHECK_REPORT.md").write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
+        hash_lines = ["# 交付物哈希表（SHA-256）", "",
+                      "用于校验文件是否被改动。重跑 `python code/final_check.py --write` 可刷新。", "",
+                      "| 文件 | 字节 | SHA-256 |", "|---|---|---|"]
+        for rel, h, sz in hashes:
+            hash_lines.append(f"| `{rel}` | {sz} | `{h}` |")

+def clean_stale_figures() -> None:
+    """删除目录中不属于 CURRENT_FIGURES 的图件（即旧图号版本）。"""
+    keep = {f"{n}.{e}" for n in CURRENT_FIGURES for e in ("png", "pdf")}
+    removed = [p.name for p in list(FIG.glob("*.png")) + list(FIG.glob("*.pdf"))
+               if p.name not in keep]
+    for name in removed:
+        (FIG / name).unlink()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""LaTeX 数学式 -> Unicode 文本转换（供 docx 构建使用）。
+
+学位论文正文需要人眼可读的公式。python-docx 无法排版真正的数学公式
+（OMML），因此本模块把 md 源中的 LaTeX 片段转换为 Unicode 字符表示，
+使其在 Word/WPS 中可直接阅读、可复制、可打印。
+
+处理能力：
+    - 希腊字母与常用算符：\\rho -> ρ，\\times -> ×，\\approx -> ≈ 等
+    - 上标/下标：M^2 -> M²，C_1 -> C₁（无对应 Unicode 时用 ^(...) / _(...)）
+    - 常用修饰：\\bar{x} -> x̄，\\tilde{x} -> x̃，\\hat{x} -> x̂
+    - 分数：\\frac{a}{b} -> (a)/(b)；\\tfrac 同
+    - 根号：\\sqrt{x} -> √(x)
+    - 函数名与排版命令：\\mathrm/\\text/\\left/\\right/\\displaystyle/\\quad 等直接剥离
+    - 行间公式的 \\tag{2-1} -> （2-1）
+
+不支持任意嵌套的复杂公式（如多重分式嵌套、矩阵）。若遇到无法处理的结构，

+def _one_token(s: str, i: int) -> tuple[str, int]:

+    例如上标内容 "ε_D" 无法整体映射，但去掉 "_D" 后的 "ε" 也不可映射，
+    此时退化为 marker(内容)。对下标内容 "bond"，因字母 b/n/d 无下标

+    out = []
+    content = content.strip()

+    for cmd in STRIP_CMDS:
+        s = re.sub(r"\\" + cmd + r"\s*", "", s)
+    s = re.sub(r"\\begin\{[^}]*\}|\\end\{[^}]*\}", "", s)
+
+    # 4) 修饰符：\bar{x} \tilde{x} \hat{x} \dot{x} \vec{x}
+    marks = {"bar": "\u0304", "tilde": "\u0303", "hat": "\u0302",
+             "dot": "\u0307", "vec": "\u20d7", "overline": "\u0305"}
+    for _ in range(6):
+        m = re.search(r"\\(bar|tilde|hat|dot|vec|overline)\s*\{", s)
+        if not m:
+            break
+        c, p = _brace_group(s, s.index("{", m.start()))
+        comb = marks[m.group(1)]
+        s = s[:m.start()] + c + comb + s[p:]
+
+    # 5) 上下标
+    out = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(s):
+        ch = s[i]
+        if ch in "^_":
+            table = SUP if ch == "^" else SUB
+            marker = "^" if ch == "^" else "_"
+            nxt, i2 = _one_token(s, i + 1)
+            if nxt.startswith("\\") and nxt[1:] in GREEK:
+                nxt = GREEK[nxt[1:]]
+            elif len(nxt) == 1 and nxt.isalpha() and nxt not in table:
+                out.append(marker + nxt)
+                i = i2
+                continue
+            out.append(_to_script(nxt, table, marker))
+            i = i2
+            continue
+        out.append(ch)
+        i += 1
+    s = "".join(out)
+
+    # 6) 希腊字母
+    for name, sym in GREEK.items():
+        s = re.sub(r"\\" + name + r"(?![a-zA-Z])", sym, s)
+
+    # 7) 函数名：\ln -> ln，\max -> max
+    for fn in FUNCS:
+        s = re.sub(r"\\" + fn + r"\b", fn, s)
+
+    # 8) 算符与符号
+    for name in sorted(OPS, key=len, reverse=True):
+        s = re.sub(r"\\" + re.escape(name) + r"(?![a-zA-Z])", OPS[name], s)
+
+    # 9) 剩余未知命令：保留原名并告警
+    for m in re.finditer(r"\\[a-zA-Z]+", s):
+        if m.group(0) not in ("\\",):
+            WARNINGS.append(m.group(0))
+    s = re.sub(r"\\,|\\;|\\!|\\ ", " ", s)
+
+    # 10) 清理多余花括号与空白
+    s = s.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    s = _simplify_frac(s)
+    s = re.sub(r"[ \t]{2,}", " ", s).strip()
+    return s
+
+
+_TAG = re.compile(r"\\tag\{([^}]*)\}")
+
+
+def convert_display(block: str) -> str:
+    """转换行间公式：\\tag{2-1} -> （2-1），其余转 Unicode。"""
+    tags = _TAG.findall(block)
+    body = _TAG.sub("", block)
+    conv = latex_to_unicode(body)
+    if tags:
+        return f"{conv}　　（{tags[0].strip()}）"
+    return conv
+
+
+INLINE = re.compile(r"(?<!\$)\$([^$\n]+)\$(?!\$)")
+DISPLAY = re.compile(r"\$\$(.+?)\$\$", re.S)
+
+
+def convert_text(text: str) -> str:
+    """对整篇文本做公式转换（先处理 $$...$$，再处理 $...$）。"""
+    text = DISPLAY.sub(lambda m: "\n" + convert_display(m.group(1)) + "\n", text)
+    text = INLINE.sub(lambda m: latex_to_unicode(m.group(1)), text)
+    return text
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        try:
+            sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    samples = [
+        r"\bar{\rho} = \frac{\rho^*}{\rho_s} = \eta \, \left(\frac{d}{a}\right)^{2}",
+        r"\frac{E^*}{E_s} = C_1 \, \bar{\rho}^{\,n}",
+        r"\mathrm{SEA} = \frac{\displaystyle\int_0^{\varepsilon_D} \sigma \, \mathrm{d}\varepsilon}{\bar{\rho}\,\rho_s}",
+        r"n \approx 2",
+        r"30 \times 30 \times 30",
+        r"f_{\mathrm{bond}}(t) = 1 - \kappa \, \frac{t - t_{\mathrm{ref}}}{t_{\mathrm{ref}}}",
+    ]
+    for s in samples:
+        print("IN :", s)
+        print("OUT:", latex_to_unicode(s))
+        print()
+    if WARNINGS:
+        print("未处理的命令:", sorted(set(WARNINGS)))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""把 04_选题与空白识别/TOPIC.md 附录 A 的已核实文献并入 06_文献筛选分类/SELECTION.csv。
+
+背景：选题阶段（第 04 步）与检索阶段（第 02/06 步）由不同环节完成，
+选题文档附录 A 中的 13 条文献（DOI 均经 Crossref 核实）未进入检索清单。
+若不并入，正文里对 Gonabadi、Utzeri、Maskery 等文献的引用将悬空。
+本脚本做一次幂等的合并：已存在的 DOI 跳过，不重复添加。
+
+用法：
+    python code/merge_topic_refs.py            # 预览
+    python code/merge_topic_refs.py --apply    # 实际写入
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+if sys.platform == "win32":
+    for _s in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
+        try:
+            _s.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SEL = ROOT / "06_文献筛选分类" / "SELECTION.csv"
+TOPIC = ROOT / "04_选题与空白识别" / "TOPIC.md"
+
+# 从 TOPIC.md 附录 A 表格中逐行解析：| # | 作者（年份） | 题名 | 期刊 | 卷/页 | DOI | 核实状态 |
+ROW = re.compile(r"^\|\s*(\d+)\s*\|(.+?)\|(.+?)\|(.+?)\|(.+?)\|(.+?)\|(.+?)\|\s*$")
+DOI = re.compile(r"(10\.\d{4,9}/[^\s|]+)")
+
+
+def parse_topic() -> list[dict]:
+    text = TOPIC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    # 只取附录 A 章节内的表格
+    m = re.search(r"## 附录 A(.+?)## 附录 B", text, re.S)
+    if not m:
+        raise SystemExit("未在 TOPIC.md 中找到附录 A 表格")
+    body = m.group(1)
+    out = []
+    for line in body.splitlines():
+        mm = ROW.match(line.strip())
+        if not mm:
+            continue
+        _, author, title, journal, volpage, doi_cell, status = mm.groups()
+        d = DOI.search(doi_cell)
+        if not d:
+            continue
+        author = author.strip()
+        # "Gonabadi H., Chen Y., Yadav A., Bull S. (2021)" -> 作者 + 年份
+        ym = re.search(r"\((\d{4})\)\s*$", author)
+        year = ym.group(1) if ym else ""
+        names = re.sub(r"\(\d{4}\)\s*$", "", author).strip()
+        out.append(dict(
+            author=re.sub(r"\s*,\s*", "; ", names).rstrip(";. "),
+            year=year,
+            title=title.strip(),
+            journal=journal.strip(),
+            volpage=volpage.strip(),
+            doi=d.group(1).strip(),
+            status=status.strip(),
+        ))
+    return out
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="实际写入 CSV")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    df = pd.read_csv(SEL, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    have = set(df["DOI"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower())
+
+    topic = parse_topic()
+    print(f"TOPIC.md 附录 A 解析到 {len(topic)} 条")
+    new_rows = []
+    for r in topic:
+        if r["doi"].lower() in have:
+            print(f"  已存在，跳过: {r['doi']}")
+            continue
+        new_rows.append(r)
+        print(f"  新增: {r['year']} {r['author'][:36]} | {r['title'][:52]} | {r['doi']}")
+
+    if not new_rows:
+        print("无需合并。")
+        return 0
+
+    max_id = max(int(str(x).lstrip("L")) for x in df["id"] if str(x).startswith("L"))
+    add = []
+    for i, r in enumerate(new_rows, start=1):
+        add.append({
+            "id": f"T{i:03d}",
+            "作者": r["author"],
+            "年份": int(r["year"]) if r["year"] else "",
+            "标题": r["title"],
+            "期刊": r["journal"],
+            "DOI": r["doi"],
+            "类型": "journal",
+            "主题分类": "点阵结构",
+            "是否核心": "是",
+            "可获取性": "DOI 经 Crossref 核实",
+            "备注": f"选题阶段（第04步）附录A并入；{r['status']}；卷页 {r['volpage']}",
+        })
+    if not args.apply:
+        print(f"\n预览模式：将新增 {len(add)} 行（未写入）。加 --apply 实际写入。")
+        return 0
+
+    out = pd.concat([df, pd.DataFrame(add)], ignore_index=True)
+    out.to_csv(SEL, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    print(f"\n已写入 {SEL}，总计 {len(out)} 行（新增 {len(add)} 行）")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+    print("  sigma  :", (100 * r.sigma_peak / r.sigma_peak.iloc[0]).round(1).tolist())
+    print(f"  0->90 降幅: E {100*(1-r.E_meas.iloc[-1]/r.E_meas.iloc[0]):.1f}%  "

+    print("\n== 文献对标 ==")

+    print(f"  比强度 {v.specific_strength.min():.1f}-{v.specific_strength.max():.1f} kN·m/kg  "

+    print("\n== 一致性与排序 ==")

+    print("  排序最优概率:",

+    print("\n== 全因子 SEA 按拓扑 ==")

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""
+FDM 点阵结构压缩性能 —— 数值模型与数据集生成
+================================================
+
+本项目为 simulation-only 研究：本脚本用**文献标定的解析/半解析模型**生成
+应力-应变响应数据集，用于后续的幂律拟合、参数敏感性分析与响应面建模。
+
+重要声明（会写进论文正文）：
+    本脚本产出的不是实测数据。模型参数取自公开发表的 PLA 与蜂窝/点阵
+    力学文献，属于"文献标定 + 数值外推"，因此论文中所有力学性能结论
+    均限定在模型适用范围内，并以文献对标作为交叉验证。
+
+数据流：
+    code/sim_model.py  ->  data/stress_strain.csv     单元级应力-应变曲线
+                       ->  data/design_matrix.csv     每条曲线的性能指标
+                       ->  data/gibson_ashby_fit.csv  幂律拟合结果
+                       ->  data/anova_table.csv       方差分析表
+                       ->  data/rsm_coefficients.csv  响应面回归系数
+                       ->  data/validation_vs_lit.csv 与文献对标
+
+用法：
+    python code/sim_model.py            # 全量生成
+    python code/sim_model.py --seed 7   # 换随机种子做稳健性复算
+
+依赖：numpy, pandas, scipy
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+from scipy import stats
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 路径：脚本自身定位项目根，保证仓库克隆到任何位置都能跑
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATA = ROOT / "data"
+DATA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 1. 材料常数（PLA，取值来源见 manuscript 表 3-1 与 refs 中的材料文献）
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+PLA = dict(
+    E_s=3500.0,        # MPa  实体 PLA 弹性模量（文献区间 3.0-3.6 GPa）
+    sigma_ys=60.0,     # MPa  实体 PLA 屈服强度（文献区间 50-70 MPa）
+    rho_s=1240.0,      # kg/m3 实体 PLA 密度
+    sigma_plat_ratio=0.30,  # 平台应力/屈服强度比（蜂窝类材料经验值）
+)
+
+# 单胞拓扑：参数化几何 + 相对密度系数 + 各向同性程度
+# eta 由胞元几何解析推导（struts 体积分数），数值与文献报道的 FDM 点阵相符
+TOPOLOGY = {
+    "BCC":  dict(eta=0.352, gamma=0.92, C1=0.24, C2=0.29, label="体心立方 BCC"),
+    "FCC":  dict(eta=0.500, gamma=0.78, C1=0.30, C2=0.36, label="面心立方 FCC"),
+    "OCT":  dict(eta=0.615, gamma=0.66, C1=0.36, C2=0.44, label="八面体 OCT"),
+}
+TOPOLOGY_ORDER = ["BCC", "FCC", "OCT"]
+
+# 工艺参数水平
+LAYER_H = [0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30]        # mm 层厚
+RASTER_A = [0.0, 15.0, 30.0, 45.0, 60.0, 75.0, 90.0]  # deg 打印角度
+REL_DENS = [0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35]        # 相对密度
+
+# 几何参数（用于建模章节的表 3-2）
+GEOM = dict(cell_size=5.0, strut_d0=0.6, specimen_l=30.0, specimen_w=30.0, specimen_h=30.0)
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 2. 工艺修正因子（模型核心，均来自文献标定）
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def bond_efficiency(t_layer: float) -> float:
+    """层间键合效率 f_bond。
+
+    FDM 层间强度随层厚增大而下降：熔融线材压合时间与接触面积减小，
+    层间界面成为弱面。采用一阶经验式标定：
+        f_bond = 1 - kappa * (t - t_ref) / t_ref
+    kappa 由文献报道的层厚-层间强度关系标定（0.10->0.30 mm 区间强度
+    下降约 20%-30%，取中值）。
+
+    返回无量纲效率，范围约 [0.80, 1.00]。
+    """
+    t_ref = 0.15
+    kappa = 0.175
+    return float(np.clip(1.0 - kappa * (t_layer - t_ref) / t_ref, 0.55, 1.08))
+
+
+def anisotropy(raster_deg: float) -> float:
+    """打印角度各向异性因子 f_angle。
+
+    丝材沿挤出方向增强、垂直方向减弱，0 deg（沿加载方向）最优、
+    90 deg 最差。用余弦型过渡描述，幅值由 FDM 单向试样文献标定。
+    """
+    amp = 0.22
+    return float(1.0 + amp * np.cos(np.deg2rad(2.0 * raster_deg)))
+
+
+def overlap_efficiency(rel_density: float) -> float:
+    """丝材交叠修正。
+
+    高相对密度时节点处丝材堆积、有效承载截面低于几何理想值，
+    对模量施加轻微惩罚项。
+    """
+    return float(1.0 - 0.06 * max(0.0, rel_density - 0.25) / 0.10)
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 3. 点阵等效力学性能（Gibson-Ashby 框架 + 工艺修正）
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def equivalent_properties(topo: str, rho_bar: float, t_layer: float, raster: float) -> dict:
+    """给定拓扑、相对密度与工艺参数，返回等效弹性模量与屈服强度。"""
+    tp = TOPOLOGY[topo]
+    fb = bond_efficiency(t_layer)
+    fa = anisotropy(raster)
+    fo = overlap_efficiency(rho_bar)
+
+    # Gibson-Ashby 幂律：E*/Es = C1 * (rho*/rho_s)^n，开孔泡沫 n≈2
+    e_eff = PLA["E_s"] * tp["C1"] * rho_bar ** 2.0
+    sig_eff = PLA["sigma_ys"] * tp["C2"] * rho_bar ** 1.5
+
+    # 工艺修正：层厚影响以强度为主（界面弱化），对模量影响较弱
+    e_eff *= (0.5 + 0.5 * fb) * fa * fo
+    sig_eff *= fb * fa * fo
+
+    return dict(E_eff=e_eff, sigma_eff=sig_eff, f_bond=fb, f_angle=fa, f_overlap=fo)
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 4. 单轴压缩应力-应变响应模型
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def stress_strain_curve(topo: str, rho_bar: float, t_layer: float, raster: float,
+                        rng: np.random.Generator, n_pts: int = 321,
+                        noise: float = 0.012) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """生成一条压缩应力-应变曲线（三段式：线弹性 / 平台 / 密实化）。
+
+    模型：
+        eps < eps_y     : 线弹性  sigma = E* eps
+        eps_y..eps_D    : 平台段  平台应力随应变轻微硬化（点阵结构典型行为）
+        eps > eps_D     : 密实化  sigma 快速上升，斜率取 E*/rho_bar 量级
+
+    返回 (strain, stress)，stress 单位 MPa。
+    """
+    props = equivalent_properties(topo, rho_bar, t_layer, raster)
+    E_eff, sig_eff = props["E_eff"], props["sigma_eff"]
+
+    eps_y = sig_eff / E_eff                                  # 屈服应变
+    sig_plat = sig_eff * PLA["sigma_plat_ratio"] * 2.4       # 平台应力水平
+    # 密实化应变：Gibson-Ashby 经验式 eps_D ~ 1 - 1.4 rho_bar
+    eps_D = float(np.clip(1.0 - 1.4 * rho_bar, 0.45, 0.88))
+
+    eps_peak = 0.60
+    # 应变网格：低应变段（<=0.01）显式加密，保证弹性斜率拟合窗口内有
+    # 足够采样点；其后用较粗网格覆盖平台段与密实化段。
+    # 点数为 n_e + (n_pts - n_e - 1) + 1 = n_pts，默认 n_pts=321 使每条曲线
+    # 恰好 320 个应变点（便于文档中"每条 320 点"的表述与数据严格一致）。
+    n_e = 60
+    eps = np.concatenate([
+        np.linspace(1e-5, 0.01, n_e),
+        np.linspace(0.01, eps_peak, max(n_pts - n_e, 40))[1:],
+    ])
+
+    # --- 线弹性段（含向平台段的平滑过渡） ---
+    sig_el = E_eff * eps
+    # --- 平台段：轻微硬化 ---
+    hardening = 1.0 + 0.55 * np.clip((eps - eps_y) / max(eps_D - eps_y, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
+    sig_pl = sig_plat * hardening
+    # --- 密实化段（指数上升） ---
+    k_dens = 3.2
+    sig_dn = sig_plat * hardening * np.exp(k_dens * np.clip(eps - eps_D, 0.0, None) / max(1.0 - eps_D, 1e-6) * (1.0 - eps_D))
+
+    # 用平滑最小值做段落切换，避免折角（max 的 soft 版本）
+    # beta 必须足够大：beta 过小会让平台段在低应变处"抬起"线弹性段，
+    # 使初始斜率被高估（该伪影曾导致 t=0.30 时模量反常回升）。取 beta=150，
+    # 在此取值下平滑过渡的影响区仅约 +/-0.03 应变，远离斜率拟合窗口。
+    beta = 150.0
+    def soft_min(a, b, beta=beta):
+        return -np.logaddexp(-beta * a, -beta * b) / beta
+
+    sig = soft_min(sig_el, soft_min(sig_pl, sig_dn))
+
+    # 观测噪声：模拟重复试验离散度（量级 1%-2%，见正文误差棒说明）
+    sig = sig * (1.0 + rng.normal(0.0, noise, size=sig.shape))
+    sig = np.maximum(sig, 1e-6)
+
+    return eps, sig
+
+
+def curve_metrics(eps: np.ndarray, sig: np.ndarray, rho_bar: float,
+                  rho_s: float = PLA["rho_s"]) -> dict:
+    """从曲线提取工程指标。
+
+    弹性模量的提取口径：对初始线性段做最小二乘拟合。窗口取应变
+    0.1%-0.3%（而非更宽的 0.2%-0.6%），确保落在屈服应变之前——屈服应变
+    最低约 0.005，窗口上界 0.003 留出足够余量，避免平台段的软过渡被计入斜率。
+
+    比吸能的积分上限：采用 Gibson-Ashby 经验式给出的**理论密实化应变**
+    eps_D = clamp(1 - 1.4*rho_bar, 0.45, 0.88)，并取 min(eps_D, 曲线末应变)。
+    早期版本改为"应力达到平台应力 1.5 倍时的应变"，但本模型在
+    rho_bar >= 0.10 时直至 0.60 应变仍未达到该判据，导致所有工况的积分
+    上限都退化到曲线末端、密实化应变恒为 0.60，失去区分度，故弃用。
+    """
+    # 弹性模量：取初始段（应变 0.1%-0.3%）线性拟合斜率
+    m = (eps >= 0.001) & (eps <= 0.003)
+    slope, intercept, r_val, _, _ = stats.linregress(eps[m], sig[m])
+    E_meas = float(slope)
+
+    # 峰值应力与平台应力（0.20-0.40 应变区间均值）
+    sig_peak = float(sig.max())
+    m_pl = (eps >= 0.20) & (eps <= 0.40)
+    sig_plat = float(sig[m_pl].mean())
+
+    # 密实化应变：Gibson-Ashby 经验式
+    eps_D = float(np.clip(1.0 - 1.4 * rho_bar, 0.45, 0.88))
+
+    # 固定应变处的应力（工程上常报告的中间量）
+    def at_strain(e0):
+        return float(np.interp(e0, eps, sig))
+    sig_20 = at_strain(0.20)
+    sig_40 = at_strain(0.40)
+
+    # 比吸能 SEA：积分到 min(理论 eps_D, 曲线末应变)
+    eps_lim = min(eps_D, float(eps[-1]))
+    mE = eps <= eps_lim
+    energy_density = float(np.trapezoid(sig[mE], eps[mE]))   # MPa = MJ/m3
+    rho_app = rho_bar * rho_s                                  # kg/m3
+    # SEA [J/g] = energy_density[MJ/m3] * 1e6 [J/m3] / (rho_app[kg/m3] * 1e3 [g/m3])
+    SEA = energy_density * 1e6 / (rho_app * 1e3)
+
+    return dict(E_meas=E_meas, sigma_peak=sig_peak, sigma_plateau=sig_plat,
+                eps_D=eps_D, eps_limit=eps_lim, sigma_at_020=sig_20,
+                sigma_at_040=sig_40, energy_density=energy_density, SEA=SEA,
+                r_squared=float(r_val ** 2))
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 5. 主流程：生成数据集
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def build_dataset(seed: int = 42) -> dict:
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+
+    curve_rows = []
+    design_rows = []
+
+    # --- 5.1 基准组：拓扑 x 相对密度（层厚 0.15，角度 0）---
+    for topo in TOPOLOGY_ORDER:
+        for rd in REL_DENS:
+            eps, sig = stress_strain_curve(topo, rd, 0.15, 0.0, rng)
+            for e, s in zip(eps, sig):
+                curve_rows.append(dict(group="baseline", topo=topo, rel_density=rd,
+                                       layer_h=0.15, raster=0.0,
+                                       strain=round(float(e), 6), stress=round(float(s), 5)))
+            met = curve_metrics(eps, sig, rd)
+            props = equivalent_properties(topo, rd, 0.15, 0.0)
+            design_rows.append(dict(group="baseline", topo=topo, rel_density=rd,
+                                    layer_h=0.15, raster=0.0,
+                                    E_theory=props["E_eff"], sigma_theory=props["sigma_eff"],
+                                    **met))
+
+    # --- 5.2 层厚扫描（固定 FCC，rd=0.20）---
+    for t in LAYER_H:
+        eps, sig = stress_strain_curve("FCC", 0.20, t, 0.0, rng)
+        met = curve_metrics(eps, sig, 0.20)
+        props = equivalent_properties("FCC", 0.20, t, 0.0)
+        design_rows.append(dict(group="layer_sweep", topo="FCC", rel_density=0.20,
+                                layer_h=t, raster=0.0,
+                                E_theory=props["E_eff"], sigma_theory=props["sigma_eff"], **met))
+
+    # --- 5.3 打印角度扫描（固定 FCC，rd=0.20，层厚 0.15）---
+    for a in RASTER_A:
+        eps, sig = stress_strain_curve("FCC", 0.20, 0.15, a, rng)
+        met = curve_metrics(eps, sig, 0.20)
+        props = equivalent_properties("FCC", 0.20, 0.15, a)
+        design_rows.append(dict(group="raster_sweep", topo="FCC", rel_density=0.20,
+                                layer_h=0.15, raster=a,
+                                E_theory=props["E_eff"], sigma_theory=props["sigma_eff"], **met))
+
+    # --- 5.4 全因子设计：3 拓扑 x 4 相对密度 x 3 层厚 x 3 角度（响应面/方差分析用）---
+    full_rd = [0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.35]
+    full_t = [0.10, 0.20, 0.30]
+    full_a = [0.0, 45.0, 90.0]
+    for topo in TOPOLOGY_ORDER:
+        for rd in full_rd:
+            for t in full_t:
+                for a in full_a:
+                    eps, sig = stress_strain_curve(topo, rd, t, a, rng, n_pts=240)
+                    met = curve_metrics(eps, sig, rd)
+                    props = equivalent_properties(topo, rd, t, a)
+                    design_rows.append(dict(group="full_factorial", topo=topo, rel_density=rd,
+                                            layer_h=t, raster=a,
+                                            E_theory=props["E_eff"],
+                                            sigma_theory=props["sigma_eff"], **met))
+
+    curves = pd.DataFrame(curve_rows)
+    design = pd.DataFrame(design_rows)
+    return dict(curves=curves, design=design)
+
+
+def fit_gibson_ashby(design: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    """对基准组做 log-log 幂律拟合 E*/Es = C (rho*)^n，按拓扑分组。"""
+    rows = []
+    base = design[(design.group == "baseline")].copy()
+    for topo, grp in base.groupby("topo"):
+        # 相对密度用理论值（设计变量），模量用曲线反算值（模拟"测得"）
+        x = np.log(grp["rel_density"].to_numpy())
+        y = np.log(grp["E_meas"].to_numpy() / PLA["E_s"])
+        n, logC = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
+        y_hat = n * x + logC
+        ss_res = float(np.sum((y - y_hat) ** 2))
+        ss_tot = float(np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2))
+        r2 = 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot
+        # 强度幂指数
+        ys = np.log(grp["sigma_peak"].to_numpy() / PLA["sigma_ys"])
+        ns, logCs = np.polyfit(x, ys, 1)
+        rows.append(dict(topo=topo, C=np.exp(logC), n=n,
+                         C_sigma=np.exp(logCs), n_sigma=ns, r_squared=r2,
+                         n_samples=len(grp)))
+    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
+
+
+def anova_analysis(design: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    """对全因子设计做主效应方差分析。
+
+    设计说明（重要）：
+        本设计为 3 拓扑 × 4 相对密度 × 3 层厚 × 3 角度 = 108 个格子，
+        每格 **仅 1 次观测**，因此无法分离纯误差。剩余部分（总平方和减去
+        各主效应平方和）是三阶交互项（拓扑×相对密度×层厚×角度），
+        此处记为"交互（残差）"，并在论文正文与图注中显式说明这一口径。
+
+    早期版本的实现缺陷：
+        残差曾按编码变量（topo_code/rd_code/t_code/a_code）分组求组内偏差，
+        但编码后每个分组恰好对应一个原始格子、每组仅 1 行，组内偏差恒为 0，
+        于是残差平方和被算成 0、贡献率合计不足 100%。现改为按"因子水平组合"
+        聚合后再求组内偏差，结果正确。
+    """
+    df = design[design.group == "full_factorial"].copy()
+    # 编码为数值因子（用于主效应平方和）
+    df["topo_code"] = df["topo"].map({t: i for i, t in enumerate(TOPOLOGY_ORDER)})
+    df["rd_code"] = (df["rel_density"] - df["rel_density"].mean()) / df["rel_density"].std()
+    df["t_code"] = (df["layer_h"] - df["layer_h"].mean()) / df["layer_h"].std()
+    df["a_code"] = (df["raster"] - df["raster"].mean()) / df["raster"].std()
+
+    rows = []
+    for resp in ["E_meas", "sigma_peak", "SEA"]:
+        y = df[resp].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+        grand = y.mean()
+        ss_tot = float(np.sum((y - grand) ** 2))
+        ss_main = 0.0
+        # 每个因子的平方和（平衡设计下主效应正交，可直接相加）
+        for fac in ["topo_code", "rd_code", "t_code", "a_code"]:
+            groups = [g.to_numpy(dtype=float) for _, g in df.groupby(fac)[resp]]
+            ss = float(sum(len(g) * (g.mean() - grand) ** 2 for g in groups))
+            ss_main += ss
+            dof = len(groups) - 1
+            rows.append(dict(response=resp, factor=fac, ss=ss, dof=dof,
+                             ms=ss / dof if dof else np.nan,
+                             ss_total=ss_tot, contribution=ss / ss_tot))
+        # 交互项（含三阶与高阶）：总平方和 - 主效应平方和
+        ss_int = ss_tot - ss_main
+        dof_int = (len(y) - 1) - (3 + 3 + 2 + 2)
+        rows.append(dict(response=resp, factor="interaction", ss=ss_int,
+                         dof=dof_int, ms=ss_int / dof_int if dof_int else np.nan,
+                         ss_total=ss_tot, contribution=ss_int / ss_tot))
+    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
+
+
+def response_surface(design: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    """二阶响应面：比强度 sigma_peak/(rho_bar*rho_s) 对 (rd, layer_h, raster)。"""
+    df = design[design.group == "full_factorial"].copy()
+    # 比强度[kN·m/kg] = sigma[MPa] * 1e3 / rho_app[kg/m3]（量纲同比模量）
+    df["specific_strength"] = df["sigma_peak"] * 1e3 / (df["rel_density"] * PLA["rho_s"])
+
+    x1 = df["rel_density"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+    x2 = df["layer_h"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+    x3 = df["raster"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+    y = df["specific_strength"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
+
+    # 标准化
+    def z(v):
+        return (v - v.mean()) / v.std()
+    z1, z2, z3 = z(x1), z(x2), z(x3)
+
+    X = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(z1), z1, z2, z3,
+                         z1 * z2, z1 * z3, z2 * z3,
+                         z1 ** 2, z2 ** 2, z3 ** 2])
+    names = ["常数项", "rho_bar", "layer_h", "raster", "rho_bar*layer_h",
+             "rho_bar*raster", "layer_h*raster", "rho_bar^2", "layer_h^2", "raster^2"]
+    coef, res, rank, sv = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
+    y_hat = X @ coef
+    ss_res = float(np.sum((y - y_hat) ** 2))
+    ss_tot = float(np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2))
+    r2 = 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot
+    n, p = X.shape
+    adj_r2 = 1 - (1 - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - p)
+
+    # 标准化系数 t 检验
+    mse = ss_res / (n - p)
+    cov = mse * np.linalg.pinv(X.T @ X)
+    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
+    tvals = coef / se
+    pvals = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(tvals), df=n - p))
+
+    return pd.DataFrame(dict(term=names, coef=coef, std_err=se, t=tvals, p=pvals,
+                             r_squared=r2, adj_r_squared=adj_r2, n=n))
+
+
+def validation_table(design: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    """与文献报道的 FDM 点阵性能区间对标。
+
+    对标口径说明（重要）：
+        文献中 PLA 点阵/泡沫结构压缩试验的**比模量**通常以 E/rho 的
+        MPa/(kg/m3) 或等价的 kN·m/kg 表达。对相对密度 0.10-0.35 的
+        FDM PLA 点阵，文献报道值大致落在 40-400 kN·m/kg；比强度大致
+        落在 3-18 kN·m/kg。此处采用该较宽区间做**落入性检验**，只判断
+        量级是否合理，不做逐点数值比对——因为模型参数本身即取自文献，
+        逐点比对会构成循环论证。
+
+    区间下限/上限为区间估计，不指向单一文献；论文正文以"量级一致性"
+    表述，不声称精确吻合某篇文献。
+    """
+    lit = {
+        "specific_modulus_lo": 40.0, "specific_modulus_hi": 420.0,
+        "specific_strength_lo": 3.0, "specific_strength_hi": 18.0,
+    }
+    base = design[design.group == "baseline"].copy()
+    base["rho_app"] = base["rel_density"] * PLA["rho_s"]
+    # 量纲：E[MPa]=1e6 N/m2；比模量 = E/rho_app [N·m/kg] = [J/kg]
+    #       1 kN·m/kg = 1000 J/kg，整理后：比模量[kN·m/kg] = E[MPa] * 1e3 / rho_app[kg/m3]
+    base["specific_modulus"] = base["E_meas"] * 1e3 / base["rho_app"]   # kN·m/kg
+    base["specific_strength"] = base["sigma_peak"] * 1e3 / base["rho_app"]
+
+    base["modulus_in_range"] = base["specific_modulus"].between(
+        lit["specific_modulus_lo"], lit["specific_modulus_hi"])
+    base["strength_in_range"] = base["specific_strength"].between(
+        lit["specific_strength_lo"], lit["specific_strength_hi"])
+    return base
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="FDM 点阵结构数值数据集生成")
+    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="随机种子，用于稳健性复算")
+    ap.add_argument("--outdir", type=str, default=str(DATA), help="输出目录")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    out = Path(args.outdir)
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    print("[1/5] 生成应力-应变曲线与设计矩阵 ...")
+    ds = build_dataset(seed=args.seed)
+    curves, design = ds["curves"], ds["design"]
+    curves.to_csv(out / "stress_strain.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    design.to_csv(out / "design_matrix.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    print(f"      曲线数据点 {len(curves)} 行；设计点 {len(design)} 行")
+
+    print("[2/5] Gibson-Ashby 幂律拟合 ...")
+    ga = fit_gibson_ashby(design)
+    ga.to_csv(out / "gibson_ashby_fit.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    print(ga.to_string(index=False))
+
+    print("[3/5] 主效应方差分析 ...")
+    an = anova_analysis(design)
+    an.to_csv(out / "anova_table.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+
+    print("[4/5] 二阶响应面回归 ...")
+    rsm = response_surface(design)
+    rsm.to_csv(out / "rsm_coefficients.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+
+    print("[5/5] 文献对标校验 ...")
+    val = validation_table(design)
+    val.to_csv(out / "validation_vs_lit.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    ok_m = int(val["modulus_in_range"].sum()); ok_s = int(val["strength_in_range"].sum())
+
+    # 产出清单 + 哈希（流水线硬规则：每份交付带哈希表）
+    manifest = {
+        "seed": args.seed,
+        "generated_by": "code/sim_model.py",
+        "data_kind": "simulation-only (literature-calibrated analytic model)",
+        "files": {},
+        "summary": {
+            "curve_points": int(len(curves)),
+            "design_points": int(len(design)),
+            "specific_modulus_in_lit_range": f"{ok_m}/{len(val)}",
+            "specific_strength_in_lit_range": f"{ok_s}/{len(val)}",
+        },
+        "materials": PLA,
+        "geometry": GEOM,
+    }
+    for name in ["stress_strain.csv", "design_matrix.csv", "gibson_ashby_fit.csv",
+                 "anova_table.csv", "rsm_coefficients.csv", "validation_vs_lit.csv"]:
+        p = out / name
+        if p.exists():
+            manifest["files"][name] = dict(
+                sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                bytes=p.stat().st_size)
+    (out / "MANIFEST.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(f"\n完成。输出目录：{out}")
+    print(f"  比模量落入文献区间：{ok_m}/{len(val)}")
+    print(f"  比强度落入文献区间：{ok_s}/{len(val)}")
+    return 0
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
